DWS-AEGIS-PILOT-001.name: DWS IQ 7 Aegis Pilot (3 months)
DWS-AEGIS-PILOT-001.caption: Three-month pilot of one Aegis workflow on your own hardware; fee credited to the licence.
DWS-AEGIS-PILOT-001.captionFi: Kolmen kuukauden pilotti yhdestä Aegis-työnkulusta omalla laitteistollanne; maksu hyvitetään lisenssin hinnasta.
DWS-AEGIS-PILOT-001.priceNote: €19,990 fixed, 3 months. Credited in full against the €59,990 Aegis licence if you proceed within 6 months (net cost to production unchanged at €59,990). INCLUDED: one site, one control-room workflow, one deployment-mode recommendation; only the agent set that workflow requires; local execution, evidence capture, identity verification, audit logs and human kill authority stood up on existing customer hardware or a compact edge appliance; production hardware sizing derived from measured behaviour on that workload. ACCEPTANCE KPI (binary): with the uplink severed for an agreed window — (i) the piloted workflow runs to completion, (ii) the EU AI Act Article 12 record continues to be written locally, (iii) an operator can still stop a running agent. All three must pass. A pilot that does not pass has delivered a negative result, which is a valid outcome and not a defect. OUTSIDE THE CREDIT: LWM integration; any hardware; multi-site rollout; industries beyond the one piloted; custom ERP/BIM/SCADA integrations; and the separate DWS-AEGIS-IMPL-001 implementation programme. The credit is capped at €19,990, applies only against the Aegis licence, and lapses if the customer does not proceed within 6 months. REPORTED NUMBERS: decision-path coverage (primary) and operator time per decision (secondary). Energy savings in € are recorded as the outcome of each approved recommendation, never promised. The first workflow comes from the customer, not from a catalogue. Agent steps run in the NVIDIA OpenShell sandbox (open source, included); the fee buys the tested acceptance result and its signed record.
DWS-AEGIS-PILOT-001.description: A 3-month engagement that proves the complete local-first operational path for Aegis on your existing infrastructure or a compact edge appliance, before any DGX procurement. A bounded subset of an Aegis deployment — not a rollout. INCLUDED: one site, one control-room workflow, one deployment-mode recommendation; only the agent set that workflow requires; local execution, evidence capture, identity verification, audit logs and human kill authority stood up on existing customer hardware or a compact edge appliance; production hardware sizing derived from measured behaviour on that workload. ACCEPTANCE KPI (binary): with the uplink severed for an agreed window — (i) the piloted workflow runs to completion, (ii) the EU AI Act Article 12 record continues to be written locally, (iii) an operator can still stop a running agent. All three must pass. A pilot that does not pass has delivered a negative result, which is a valid outcome and not a defect. OUTSIDE THE CREDIT: LWM integration; any hardware; multi-site rollout; industries beyond the one piloted; custom ERP/BIM/SCADA integrations; and the separate DWS-AEGIS-IMPL-001 implementation programme. The credit is capped at €19,990, applies only against the Aegis licence, and lapses if the customer does not proceed within 6 months.
features: 3-month scoped engagement — fixed price, fixed end date, one site and one control-room workflow
Runs on existing customer hardware or a compact edge appliance; no DGX procurement required
Proves the five control-room requirements: local execution and evidence, local identity/logs/kill authority, no network dependency for the core outcome, cloud optional, specified graceful degradation
Binary acceptance KPI — uplink severed: workflow completes, Article 12 record still written locally, operator can still stop an agent. All three, or the pilot reports a negative result
Reported numbers: decision-path coverage and operator time per decision; energy € recorded as an outcome, never promised
Operator approval of each recommendation is a signed decision event in the local ledger
Agent steps sandboxed with NVIDIA OpenShell (verified 28.09.2026); the fee buys the tested, signed acceptance record
Deployment-mode recommendation (Local/Edge, Hybrid or EU-Sovereign Cloud) with production hardware sizing

DWS-IQ-006.name: Lifetime DWS IQ Platform (Version 6)
DWS-IQ-006.caption: Orchestration platform that turns Fit for 55, CSRD and EPBD obligations into audit-ready outcomes with governed agents.
DWS-IQ-006.description: Ship signed work that releases money. DWS IQ 6 is the orchestration platform that produces the signed artifact your counterparty accepts — so a tender, a shipment, an invoice or a grant can move, in days not quarters. MCP-native, CLI-accessible, EU-hosted. Supports up to 50 production agents concurrently across 25 industry verticals.
